_schema: proven-to-format batch (ad-variations). One file per batch; copy it to start a new one. brand/product/avatar/offer/route/lane/link = what every square sells and how it is made; link = the catalog link id of the landing page the ads send people to (the editor hand-off and the brief register carry it). winners = proven video ads (rows): path = their video-teardown run, ad = the ad's own name (winner record). title = the line under the page heading. formats = fresh format swipes (columns): code = the post code, record = its swipe-organic record, format_id = its id in the format library (new:<id> when proposed, not yet in it), video = the swipe video on the Drive (relative to Shared Assets), post_url, handle, run_label = the chain run that takes it to 2 Spec (fmt-<name>-<code>), run = that run's folder once it exists (the chain lowercases the label). earlier_specs = squares that already carry a spec (the old one-step format swap), shown as written on the grid. Read by machine/proven_to_format.py.
